Document: HIRING PROCESS AND RECRUITING GUIDELINES
Section: OVERVIEW AND PHILOSOPHY

The hiring process at Apex Technologies is designed to evaluate technical depth, problem-solving capability, and alignment with our collaborative culture. We prioritize objective, structured interviews and seek candidates who demonstrate curiosity, resilience, and strong communication skills.

Document: HIRING PROCESS AND RECRUITING GUIDELINES
Section: STAGES OF INTERVIEW PROCESS

1. Recruiter Screen (30 mins): Initial discussion covering candidate background, career goals, role expectations, and compensation alignment.
2. Technical Screen (60 mins): Live coding and problem-solving assessment focusing on data structures, algorithms, and practical debugging.
3. System Design and Architecture (60 mins): For mid-to-senior levels, evaluates system scalability, database trade-offs, caching, and distributed systems.
4. Hiring Manager Round (45 mins): Discussion on past projects, technical leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and team dynamics.
5. Values and Culture Fit (45 mins): Behavioral interview assessing alignment with company values, conflict resolution, and feedback receptivity.

Document: HIRING PROCESS AND RECRUITING GUIDELINES
Section: CANDIDATE EVALUATION AND SCORING

- Standardized Rubrics: Every interviewer must complete a structured scorecard in the applicant tracking system within 24 hours of the interview.
- Scoring Scale: Strong Hire, Hire, Leaning Hire, Leaning No Hire, Strong No Hire.
- Debrief Meeting: A 30-minute debrief is scheduled if there are split recommendations among the hiring panel.

Document: HIRING PROCESS AND RECRUITING GUIDELINES
Section: OFFER APPROVAL AND EXTENSION

- Compensation Banding: Offers are benchmarked against industry percentiles to maintain internal equity across levels.
- Background Verification: All candidate offers are contingent upon clear background verification (education, employment history, and criminal record check).
- Formal Extension: The hiring manager and recruiter conduct an offer call followed by sending the official digital offer letter via DocuSign.

Document: HIRING PROCESS AND RECRUITING GUIDELINES
Section: ONBOARDING HANDOVER

Once an offer is accepted:
1. Recruiter initiates the pre-onboarding workflow in the HR portal.
2. IT receives automated notification to configure and dispatch the employee's workstation.
3. Hiring Manager assigns an onboarding buddy to guide the new hire during their first 90 days.

Document: HUMAN RESOURCES POLICIES AND PROCEDURES
Section: EMPLOYEE CODE OF CONDUCT

All employees must act with integrity, professionalism, and mutual respect. Apex Technologies maintains zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, bullying, or unethical business practices. Employees are expected to protect company confidential data and report any conflicts of interest.

Document: HUMAN RESOURCES POLICIES AND PROCEDURES
Section: WORKING HOURS AND ATTENDANCE

- Regular Schedule: Monday through Friday with flexible working hours based on an 8-hour workday.
- Core Collaboration Window: 11:00 AM to 3:30 PM IST. Employees should remain accessible on Slack during this window for team synchronizations.
- Attendance Logging: Employees must record planned time off and sickness in the HRMS portal to ensure team visibility.

Document: HUMAN RESOURCES POLICIES AND PROCEDURES
Section: PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT AND APPRAISALS

- Performance Cycles: Conducted bi-annually in June (Mid-year review) and December (Annual review).
- Goal Setting (OKRs): Objectives and Key Results are agreed upon with managers at the start of each quarter.
- 360-Degree Feedback: Peer and upward feedback are incorporated into annual performance evaluations.
- Promotion Cycles: Formal promotion recommendations are evaluated during the annual review cycle.

Document: HUMAN RESOURCES POLICIES AND PROCEDURES
Section: GRIEVANCE REDRESSAL AND POSH POLICY

- Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH): Apex Technologies enforces strict POSH compliance overseen by an Internal Complaints Committee (ICC).
- Reporting Channels: Any employee can file a grievance directly to hr-support@apextech.example.com or confidentially to the ICC Presiding Officer.
- Protection Against Retaliation: The company strictly prohibits any retaliation against individuals raising concerns in good faith.

Document: HUMAN RESOURCES POLICIES AND PROCEDURES
Section: SEPARATION AND RESIGNATION PROCESS

- Notice Period: Standard notice period is 60 calendar days for full-time employees, unless mutually adjusted by department leadership.
- Exit Clearance: Completing the exit checklist includes returning all IT assets, completing knowledge transfer documentation, and attending an exit interview.
- Full and Final Settlement (FnF): Processed within 30 days of the last working day, including encashment of eligible leave balances.

Document: COMPREHENSIVE LEAVE AND ATTENDANCE POLICY
Section: ANNUAL PAID LEAVE (PTO)

- Entitlement: Full-time employees receive 22 days of paid time off per calendar year.
- Accrual: PTO accrues on a monthly basis at 1.83 days per completed month of active service.
- Carryover Rules: A maximum of 8 unused vacation days can be carried forward into the subsequent calendar year. Unused days beyond 8 will lapse automatically on December 31st.
- Advance Notice: Planned leaves of 3 or more consecutive days require at least 1 week advance manager notification.

Document: COMPREHENSIVE LEAVE AND ATTENDANCE POLICY
Section: CASUAL AND SICK LEAVE

- Allocation: 10 days of paid casual and sick leave per year, credited in advance on January 1st.
- Consecutive Sick Days: If sick leave extends beyond 3 consecutive working days, a formal medical practitioner certificate must be uploaded to HRMS.
- Carryover: Casual and sick leaves do not carry forward and cannot be encashed upon separation.

Document: COMPREHENSIVE LEAVE AND ATTENDANCE POLICY
Section: MATERNITY AND PATERNITY LEAVE

- Maternity Leave: Female employees are eligible for 26 weeks (182 calendar days) of fully paid maternity leave for up to two surviving children. Leave can begin up to 8 weeks prior to the expected delivery date.
- Paternity Leave: Male employees are entitled to 15 working days of fully paid paternity leave, usable within the first 6 months of childbirth.
- Adoption Leave: Primary adopting parents receive 16 weeks of paid leave; secondary adopting parents receive 4 weeks of paid leave.

Document: COMPREHENSIVE LEAVE AND ATTENDANCE POLICY
Section: BEREAVEMENT AND COMPASSIONATE LEAVE

- Duration: 5 consecutive working days of paid leave upon the passing of an immediate family member (spouse, child, parent, sibling, or parent-in-law).
- Additional Days: Managers may approve up to 3 additional unpaid or vacation days if travel is necessary.

Document: COMPREHENSIVE LEAVE AND ATTENDANCE POLICY
Section: LEAVE APPLICATION AND APPROVAL WORKFLOW

- Submission: All leave requests must be submitted through the self-service HRMS mobile app or web portal.
- Approval SLA: Managers must approve or reject leave requests within 48 business hours.
- Emergency Leave: In case of unexpected illness, notify your team lead via Slack or email by 9:30 AM local time on the day of absence.

Document: MEDICAL INSURANCE AND HEALTH BENEFIT POLICY
Section: GROUP HEALTH INSURANCE (GHI)

- Base Coverage: Apex Technologies provides comprehensive Group Health Insurance covering the employee, spouse, and up to two dependent children (up to age 25).
- Sum Insured: Family floater sum insured of INR 10,00,000 for India-based employees ($250,000 for US-based employees).
- Premium: 100% of the base insurance premium is covered by the company.
- Parental Insurance Top-Up: Employees have the voluntary option to enroll parents or in-laws via payroll deduction during annual open enrollment in November.

document_title: MEDICAL INSURANCE AND HEALTH BENEFIT POLICY
text:
Document: MEDICAL INSURANCE AND HEALTH BENEFIT POLICY
Section: COVERAGE DETAILS AND EXCLUSIONS

- Day-One Coverage: Pre-existing ailments and maternity complications are covered from the first day of employment without waiting periods.
- Room Rent Cap: Single Private Air-Conditioned room with no proportional deduction on associated medical charges.
- Daycare Treatments: Over 400 daycare procedures (e.g., dialysis, chemotherapy, cataract surgery) not requiring 24-hour hospitalization are covered.
- Exclusions: Cosmetic surgeries, experimental treatments, and unprescribed supplements are excluded.

Document: MEDICAL INSURANCE AND HEALTH BENEFIT POLICY
Section: OUTPATIENT (OPD) AND DENTAL REIMBURSEMENT

- OPD Allowance: Annual outpatient consultation allowance of INR 15,000 ($500) per family unit.
- Reimbursable Services: Doctor consultation fees, prescription diagnostic tests (blood tests, X-rays, MRI scans), and prescribed medicines.
- Dental and Vision: Routine checkups, cleaning, dental fillings, prescription eyeglasses, and contact lenses qualify under the OPD benefit limit.

Document: MEDICAL INSURANCE AND HEALTH BENEFIT POLICY
Section: CLAIMS SUBMISSION AND REIMBURSEMENT PROCESS

- Cashless Hospitalization: Present your MediBuddy / TPA e-card at network hospitals at least 48 hours before planned admission or within 24 hours of emergency admission.
- Reimbursement Claims: For non-network hospitals, submit original itemized discharge summaries, doctor prescriptions, and hospital bills within 30 days of discharge.
- Processing Turnaround: Approved reimbursement claims are disbursed to the employee's bank account within 10 business days.

Document: MEDICAL INSURANCE AND HEALTH BENEFIT POLICY
Section: ANNUAL EXECUTIVE HEALTH CHECKUP

- Eligibility: All full-time employees who have completed 6 months of tenure are eligible for an annual preventative health screening.
- Diagnostic Partners: Available at zero out-of-pocket cost at certified partner diagnostic centers (Apollo, Metropolis, Quest Diagnostics).
- Scope of Tests: Includes Complete Blood Count (CBC), lipid profile, liver function, kidney function, HbA1c, ECG, and physician consultation.

text:
Document: INCIDENT MANAGEMENT AND ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS (RCA)
Section: INCIDENT SEVERITY LEVELS

- SEV-1 (Critical Outage): Production service is completely down, core customer transaction flow is halted, or critical data loss is detected. Immediate 24/7 war room activation required.
- SEV-2 (Major Degradation): High-impact service degradation, significant latency spike, or core feature unavailable for a substantial subset of users. Workaround may exist.
- SEV-3 (Moderate / Minor): Low-impact bugs, non-critical admin tool defects, or isolated UI inconsistencies with minimal customer impact. Handled during normal sprint hours.

document_title: INCIDENT MANAGEMENT AND ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS (RCA)
text:
Document: INCIDENT MANAGEMENT AND ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS (RCA)
Section: RCA TIMELINE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

- Incident Commander: Owns communication during the incident and designates the primary RCA author.
- Initial Incident Summary: Published to the #eng-incidents Slack channel within 2 hours of incident mitigation.
- Draft RCA Document: Must be completed in the post-mortem repository within 48 business hours of incident resolution.
- Post-Mortem Review Meeting: Held within 5 business days, attended by relevant engineering teams, product managers, and site reliability engineers.

document_title: INCIDENT MANAGEMENT AND ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS (RCA)
text:
Document: INCIDENT MANAGEMENT AND ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS (RCA)
Section: THE 5 WHYS METHODOLOGY

Engineers must use the Five Whys analysis to uncover systemic vulnerabilities rather than stopping at immediate human or software triggers:
1. Why did the database fail? -> Connection pool exhaustion.
2. Why was connection pool exhausted? -> Sudden query spike on unindexed user lookup table.
3. Why was the lookup table unindexed? -> Migrations for feature flag rollout were executed out of order.
4. Why were migrations executed out of order? -> CI/CD pipeline lacked sequential ordering validation.
5. Why did CI/CD lack ordering validation? -> Deployment scripts were updated manually without automated verification gates.

Document: INCIDENT MANAGEMENT AND ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS (RCA)
Section: CORRECTIVE AND PREVENTIVE ACTIONS (CAPA)

- Action Item Ownership: Every RCA must produce tangible, assigned Action Items with specific target completion dates.
- Jira Tracking: Action items are tagged with label `rca-action-item` and prioritized in the immediate next sprint.
- Verification: The Security & Quality guild verifies closed action items during monthly architectural review boards.

text:
Document: INCIDENT MANAGEMENT AND ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS (RCA)
Section: BLAMELESS POST-MORTEM CULTURE

- Principle: Human error is a symptom of fragile systems, not the cause. Post-mortems must never assign individual blame or reprimand employees for honest mistakes.
- Focus: Post-mortems evaluate tooling, monitoring alerts, defensive engineering safeguards, rollback mechanisms, and operational procedures to ensure failure modes cannot reoccur.

Document: TECHNICAL ARCHITECTURE AND ENGINEERING GUIDELINES
Section: ARCHITECTURE AND SYSTEM DESIGN

- Architecture Model: Microservices with asynchronous event-driven communication powered by Kafka and RabbitMQ.
- Local AI Inference: Uses Ollama running lightweight models (qwen3:4b, nomic-embed-text) communicating over OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoints.
- High Availability: All stateless backend services run in Kubernetes clusters spanning multiple availability zones with automated horizontal pod autoscaling (HPA).
- Data Persistence: PostgreSQL for relational transactional data, Redis for distributed session caching, and ChromaDB for vector similarity indexing.

Document: TECHNICAL ARCHITECTURE AND ENGINEERING GUIDELINES
Section: REPOSITORY AND BRANCHING STANDARDS

- Version Control: GitHub Enterprise with protected main branches. Direct pushes to main are strictly prohibited.
- Branch Naming Schema:
  * Features: feat/<ticket-id>-short-summary (e.g., feat/APEX-312-ollama-streaming)
  * Bug Fixes: fix/<ticket-id>-short-summary (e.g., fix/APEX-401-json-null-pointer)
  * Hotfixes: hotfix/<ticket-id>-short-summary
- Release Tags: Semantic Versioning (vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) applied automatically upon merging release branches.

Document: TECHNICAL ARCHITECTURE AND ENGINEERING GUIDELINES
Section: CODE REVIEW AND TESTING CRITERIA

- Review Turnaround: Code reviews must be completed within 24 business hours.
- Approval Gates: At least two approving reviews required from repository code owners.
- Test Coverage Threshold: Pull requests must demonstrate at least 80% line test coverage on newly added business logic.
- Static Analysis: Ruff, Black, ESLint, and MyPy static checks must pass cleanly in pre-commit hooks and CI runs.

Document: TECHNICAL ARCHITECTURE AND ENGINEERING GUIDELINES
Section: CI/CD PIPELINE AND DEPLOYMENTS

- Pipeline Automation: GitHub Actions workflows trigger automated testing, linting, Docker image build, and vulnerability scanning upon PR creation.
- Deployment Strategy: Automated canary deployments where new releases receive 5% traffic for 30 minutes before gradual 100% rollout.
- Automated Rollbacks: If error rate exceeds 0.5% or P99 latency increases by more than 25% during canary evaluation, automated rollback initiates immediately.

Document: TECHNICAL ARCHITECTURE AND ENGINEERING GUIDELINES
Section: MONITORING, OBSERVABILITY, AND LOGGING

- Metrics: Prometheus scrape targets with Grafana dashboards providing real-time visibility into CPU, memory, and HTTP response distributions.
- Structured Logging: All services must emit structured JSON logs to stdout including timestamp, trace_id, span_id, severity level, and component name.
- Alerting: PagerDuty integrations trigger automated alerts for SEV-1 and SEV-2 incidents based on alerting rules defined in Prometheus Alertmanager.

Document: BUSINESS TRAVEL AND EXPENSE REIMBURSEMENT POLICY
Section: TRAVEL AUTHORIZATION POLICY

- Pre-Approval Requirement: All business travel (domestic and international) requires written pre-approval from the Department Head and Finance Director at least 14 days before the departure date.
- Business Justification: Travel requests must outline the direct business value, client meetings, conference speaking commitments, or cross-team collaboration objectives.
- Corporate Travel Desk: All flight tickets, rail bookings, and corporate lodging reservations must be booked through the central travel portal (MakeMyTrip Corporate / Navan).

document_title: BUSINESS TRAVEL AND EXPENSE REIMBURSEMENT POLICY
text:
Document: BUSINESS TRAVEL AND EXPENSE REIMBURSEMENT POLICY
Section: FLIGHT AND TRAIN TRAVEL GUIDELINES

- Domestic Flights: Standard Economy class only. Preferred non-stop flights should be selected when the fare differential is under 15%.
- International Flights: Economy class for flights with total travel time under 8 hours. Premium Economy or Business Class permitted for continuous flights exceeding 8 hours with VP approval.
- Rail Travel: AC 1st Class or AC 2-Tier permitted for domestic official travel where train is the optimal route.

text:
Document: BUSINESS TRAVEL AND EXPENSE REIMBURSEMENT POLICY
Section: LODGING AND HOTEL PER DIEM

- Tier-1 Metro Cities (Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, San Francisco, New York, London):
  * Maximum nightly hotel room rate: INR 6,500 (India) / $220 (US/International) inclusive of taxes.
- Tier-2 & Other Locations:
  * Maximum nightly hotel room rate: INR 4,000 (India) / $150 (US/International) inclusive of taxes.
- Direct Billing: Use partner hotels with direct corporate billing to avoid personal out-of-pocket room charges whenever possible.

Document: BUSINESS TRAVEL AND EXPENSE REIMBURSEMENT POLICY
Section: DAILY MEAL AND INCIDENTALS ALLOWANCE

- Per Diem Daily Meal Cap: Employees traveling on business can claim up to INR 1,800 ($65) per day for meals (breakfast, lunch, and dinner) during travel days.
- Local Conveyance: Airport transfers, official Uber / Ola rides, and local transit fares are reimbursable with digital trip receipts.
- Non-Reimbursable Expenses: Alcoholic beverages, hotel minibar snacks, personal laundry (unless trip exceeds 5 days), traffic citations, and flight cancellation insurance are non-reimbursable.

Section: EXPENSE SUBMISSION AND REIMBURSEMENT TIMELINE

- Submission Window: Expense reports must be submitted via Concur / HRMS within 15 calendar days of trip completion.
- Receipt Requirements: Digital itemized receipts are mandatory for all individual expenses exceeding INR 500 ($10).
